facts.fact: The Council of Ministers of 30 July 2026 adopted decrees applying law n°014-2024/ALT of 9 July 2024 on the security of information systems, one identifying and categorising critical-infrastructure bodies and another setting periodic security audits and auditor accreditation, which shows the law is in force.
